facts.fact: ISO's member register records INIQ, the National Institute of Quality Infrastructure, as Angola's body for the Angolan Quality System, a public-law institute under its Organic Statute approved by Presidential Decree 95/21 of April 2021, offering elaboration and sale of technical standards and holding correspondent membership of ISO.

facts.fact: INIQ, Angola's national quality infrastructure institute, made its 2026 Catalogue of Norms available on 9 March 2026 with 140 new national standards (Normas Angolanas) in the annual update, homologated by INIQ after technical committee work and public consultation, but the document names no standard on information technology, security, software or data.

facts.fact: Presidential Decree 95/21 of 20 April 2021 merged the Angolan standardisation institute IANORQ and the accreditation institute IAAC into the National Institute of Quality Infrastructure (INIQ), a public institute whose remit includes coordinating national standardisation, developing and publishing the national body of standards and homologating Angolan standards; the document names no national standard on information technology or data.
